DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The clinical picture of prematurity (32 weeks), cesarean delivery, and respiratory distress with tachypnea, retractions, nasal flaring, and cyanosis is highly characteristic of RDS. I will proceed with a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes.
